HoneyPet portable Windows distribution: third-party components

Python 3.12.10 (Windows x64)
  Publisher: Python Software Foundation.
  Official distribution: https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/python/3.12.10/python.3.12.10.nupkg
  License: Python Software Foundation License and bundled notices.
  The full upstream Python LICENSE.txt is at the distribution root.
  HoneyPet.exe is the unmodified upstream pythonw.exe with its filename changed.

PySide6-Essentials 6.8.3 and shiboken6 6.8.3
  Publisher: The Qt Company / Qt for Python contributors.
  Obtained from the official releases on https://pypi.org/.

  Full LGPL v3 and accompanying GPL v3 license texts are in third_party/licenses/.
  Original wheel metadata and license files are preserved in Lib/site-packages/*.dist-info/.
  Corresponding source repositories / version tags:
    https://github.com/qt/pyside-setup/tree/v6.8.3

  The runtime loads these libraries dynamically. You may replace them with
  compatible builds in Lib/site-packages, including modified builds.
  Application source is included under app/. No component above was modified.

distribution.json records the downloaded input SHA-256 hashes and versions.
